text:
sam: Hey — CI turned red on my PR (4822). pre-commit is failing with rustfmt + pyright errors, blocking merges. Can someone help bisect?

julia: Saw the failure in the run logs: rustfmt diff under packages/serving/kvcache and a pyright complaint in python/core/loader.py about a return type.

mike: I can take a look. Quick question — does this fail locally for you or only on CI?

sam: Locally my checks pass. CI uses pre-commit v2.14 + rustfmt 1.7.0; maybe a formatting config drift or a typing rename that only shows up with the strict pyright config.

ryan: Paste the pyright snippet if you have it. Might be the Tuple->List alias change from last week.

sam: Paste from CI logs:
```
python/core/loader.py:124: error: Incompatible return value type (got "Tuple[str, int]", expected "List[str]")  [return-value]
   124 | def load_meta(...) -> List[str]:
````

emily: ci-bot: Rerun queued — @sam triggered a rerun for PR 4822 :arrows_counterclockwise: (https://ci.redwood/integrations/4822)

julia: If bisect is needed, try this pattern locally:
```
git bisect start -- bad HEAD -- good v1.2.3
git bisect run ./dev/ci/bisect-runner.sh
```
It runs the same pre-commit checks we run on CI.

mike: I'm starting a bisect on a fresh clone now, will report back quick.

mike: First pass points to commit 0a9f3d2 — it touched python/core/typing_aliases.py and packages/serving/kvcache/Cargo.toml (suspect cross-language change).

sam: I can try a quick local patch: change the return annotation to Sequence[str] and adjust the alias in typing_aliases. Pushing a hotfix branch `4822-hotfix-typing` for CI to re-evaluate.

emily: ci-bot: Hotfix branch build started for 4822-hotfix-typing :rocket:

julia: Nice. If that passes, we should add a short note in the release checklist about keeping pyright/rustfmt versions in sync across dev images.

mike: Bisect confirmed 0a9f3d2 as first bad. Filing a tiny follow-up PR to add a targeted test and update typing_aliases.

sam: CI for the hotfix shows green on pre-commit and pyright now — thanks all. :white_check_mark: Going to merge after one more quick review.

emily: ci-bot: PR 4822-hotfix-typing succeeded all checks and was merged by sam. :tada:
